title: To revoke the charter of incorporation of the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma at the request of that tribe, and for other purposes.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Accepts the request of the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma to revoke the charter of incorporation issued to that tribe and ratified by its members on June 1, 1940.

summary.headline: Congress accepted a request from the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma to revoke its 1940 federal charter of incorporation.
summary.what_it_does: The law accepts the tribe's request to cancel the charter of incorporation that was issued to the tribe in 1940 and ratified by its members on June 1, 1940. A charter is a federal document that set out how the tribe was organized as a legal entity. The summary does not describe what the tribe will use in its place or any other steps the law requires.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma
who_it_affects.how: The legal charter that the tribe was organized under since 1940 is revoked at the tribe's own request.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 6, 2015. The summary does not list any later dates.
